provision_user: UID0 only trusted Debian toolchain install; UID10001 all npm/source operations
toolchain_script:
set -eu
apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root install -y --no-install-recommends git build-essential python3 ca-certificates
node --version
npm --version
git --version
python3 --version
g++ --version
dpkg-query -W
network_install_script:
set -eu
cd /opt/replay/seed
node --version
npm --version
git rev-parse HEAD
git rev-parse origin/main
npm cache add /opt/replay/provenance/wxyc-shared-4.1.0.tgz --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund
offline_script:
set -eu
cd /opt/replay/seed
node --version
npm --version
npm rebuild --offline --no-audit --no-fund
python3 /opt/replay/provenance/verify_seed.py
lifecycle_policy: npm ci ignore-scripts online, original npm rebuild offline; no tests/Jest/candidate
transport_rewrite: SSH to HTTPS for identical original public git repo/commit only; original lock unchanged
